messages:
maria: Heads-up — running a small probe on head-wise quant routing for Llama-3-13B. Baseline FP8 vs headwise-mix (FP8 on top heads, 4-bit on others). Want to share perf + quality tradeoffs.
josh: Nice. How are you deciding which heads get higher precision?
maria: Using importance scores from a 1k-sequence probe: head_entropy and grad-L2. Threshold at top 20%.
kevin: Do we do this offline per-model, or per-request at runtime?
maria: Plan: offline profile -> produce a precision map per model version; runtime applies map with cheap per-request hints (prompt length, task).
taylor: Any kernel support required? Switching head precision within a single forward could be messy.
maria: Runtime needs head-sliced kernels. Prototype: run attention in two batches: high-precision batch -> low-precision batch. Adds ~5% extra kernel launches but reduces FLOPS by ~30%.
quant-bot: Autotest summary: headwise-probe A/B (n=500). avg latency +3.8%, tokens/sec +27%, ROUGE-L delta -0.9% (p<0.01).
josh: -0.9% ROUGE is borderline. Any signal for hallucination increase?
maria: We measured factuality via NQ BERTScore: drop 0.6 points. Most prompts ok, but long-context summarization shows larger degradation in a small slice.
kevin: Can we hybrid fallback: if logp drop > X or perplexity spike during generation, route the whole request to full-precision path?
maria: Yes. Proposed fallback policy: monitor mean token logp delta vs baseline over first 25 tokens; if delta < -0.75, hot-swap entire request to FP8/FP32 path. Config snippet:
```json
{
  "precision_strategy": "headwise",
  "high_precision_heads": ["top20"],
  "profile_version": "v1.2",
  "fallback": {
    "metric": "mean_logp_delta",
    "window": 25,
    "threshold": -0.75,
    "action": "route_full_fp8"
  }
}
```
taylor: Telemetry hooks needed: head-level activation stats, logp-delta histogram, fallback rate per 1k requests.
maria: Will add telemetry + canary 1% traffic on a dedicated pool. Looking for volunteers to run the canary this week.
josh: I'll carve out an hour Fri to help. Also need a runbook for rollback if hallucination spikes.
maria: Draft runbook: notify #eng-oncall, scale to full-precision, tag traces with precision-route, revert profile -> previous model snapshot.
kevin: One more ask: add a synthetic adversarial prompt set to catch rare degradations.
maria: Added to TODO. Thanks all :thumbsup:
